name: Self-destruct
description: When the creature dies, it explodes in a spray of Void-infused crystal shards. Each creature within 5 feet of the creature must succeed on a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw or take 3 (1d6) slashing damage and 3 (1d6) psychic damage. Grimmlets damaged by this trait don’t Reproduce.
